title: AI & Agent Security
blurb: Attack a real LLM agent — poison its retrieval, hijack its planner, chain its tools to exfiltrate data — then build the guardrails that stop each one and measure the difference.
long_description: Most AI-security training stops at 'jailbreak the chatbot'. This Area gives you a full agentic system — LangGraph planner + executor, a SQL tool, an email tool, a file tool, a RAG store and persistent memory — that is deliberately vulnerable, running on your own machine. You exploit it for real (real SQL, real SMTP, real retrieval), then flip SECURE_MODE and watch specific guardrails block specific steps. Every scenario ends with a measured before/after.

env.notes: Ollama stays inside the Docker network. Graded steps never require it.

credential.title: AI Security Practitioner
credential.description: Proves you can exploit an agent end-to-end and implement the six control layers that stop it.

prerequisites: Comfortable with a terminal and Docker Compose
Basic Python reading ability (you will open the lab's defense code)
outcomes: Explain the agent data path: user → RAG → planner (LLM) → executor → tools
Demonstrate SQL injection, path traversal and cross-tool exfiltration through agent tooling
Execute an indirect prompt injection that turns retrieved documents into agent instructions
Map every finding to OWASP LLM Top 10 and Agentic ASI categories
Implement and verify six control layers outside the model
Produce a before/after attack-success table as evidence
